description: Vista designs, finances, installs, and manages energy storage and solar at commercial, industrial, and multifamily properties for $0 upfront, helping businesses save up to 30% on their energy bills. The founding team previously worked at SpaceX, Rocket Lab, NASA and Firefly.

name: Healia
one_liner: Modern health insurance for dual income families
description:
Healia is reinventing health insurance for dual income families. Our product enables companies to pay for the out of pocket costs of any employee that enrolls in their spouse's health insurance plan. This saves customers $10k per enrollee while providing an incredible employee perk: 100% coverage of a family's health costs.

We’re now up to 50+ customers coast-to-coast with over 40k employees using our product!

name: Egress Health
one_liner: Automated revenue cycle management, starting with dentists
description: Egress Health builds AI agents to automate revenue cycle management, starting with dental offices. Our workflows span eligibility checks, claims scrubbing, payment posting, and denial management. On average, our customers eliminate 1-2 full time employees and collect 5-15% more revenue each month. Interested in learning more? Shoot us a note at founders@tryegress.com

name: Dollyglot
one_liner: Character.AI with real time video avatars
description:
Dollyglot is like Character.ai but with real time video avatars.
Turn a photo and a voice into a real friend. Speak with Harry Potter about Hogwarts or brainstorm ideas with Elon Musk!

name: Paragon
one_liner: The AI Growth Engine for Industrials
description: Paragon is the AI growth engine for distributors and manufacturers, freeing up staff and growing revenue on autopilot.

name: Lucid
one_liner: interactive video models
description:
We are building universe simulations powered by interactive video models.

We train video models that simulate hyper-realistic environments with immersive control, replacing hard-coded game or physics engines with dynamic neural networks.

We built the fastest action-conditioned diffusion video model (running at 20+fps on a 4090 gaming gpu) to simulate minecraft. It is 5x faster than other minecraft World Models and was trained with 100x less resources. name: Mesh
one_liner: Eliminating accrual spreadsheets for faster month-end
description:
Month-end shouldn’t be a race against the clock.

For most mid-to-enterprise finance teams, accruals are a manual bottleneck. Chasing missing invoices and manually updating spreadsheets can eat up 4+ days of every month-end close.

Mesh changes the timeline. We automate 90% of the accruals process by capturing real-time usage and service signals directly from your AP inbox, Slack, Teams, and historical journals. We turn fragmented data into audit-ready outputs, so you can stop guessing and start closing.

See how top teams are accelerating their close by 4+ days at www.usemesh.com

name: Butter
one_liner: Embedded Sandboxes for Agents
description:
Butter is building bVisor, an incredibly lightweight sandbox runtime for AI agents.
It embeds directly into your local process, providing a safe bash environment without the overhead of VMs or remote infra.

name: Button Computer
one_liner: The tiny computer built for voice AI.
description: We’re launching a small hardware device: a button that you clip to your shirt. You press it to talk to AI, and it responds instantly.

name: Kita
one_liner: Automate credit assessment for lenders in emerging markets
description:
In emerging markets, open finance is still nascent. Most of the population is traditionally unbanked, banking APIs don’t exist, and a borrower’s financial history lives in documents: e-wallet records, bank statements, utility bills, and more. Because this data is unstructured, credit and risk teams are forced into manual review. This slows decisioning, increases costs, and caps lending volume. 

Kita is the AI platform for global lending operations. We help lenders in emerging markets automate application completion, document verification, and underwriting from messy financial documents — us

name: Kyten Technologies
one_liner: Custom Aerospace-Grade Battery Packs
description:
Kyten Technologies is building a factory to manufacture custom aerospace-grade battery packs. 
100,000+ drones, submarines, and satellites are being built in the US, but the legacy supply chain can't keep up. 
During our six years at Starlink, we put 5,000+ battery packs into space. Now, we're bringing rapid development and volume production of aerospace-grade battery packs to the entire industry.

name: Ventura
one_liner: AI Workforce for Distributors and Manufacturers
description: Ventura builds the AI workforce for distributors and manufacturers, starting with quoting and order entry. It plugs into your existing ERP, follows your SOPs, and learns your team's tribal knowledge - getting smarter with every completed task.

name: Maywood
one_liner: The first finance-compliant proactive AI that runs 24/7
description:
Maywood is the first finance-compliant proactive AI that runs 24/7, working across your network, pipeline, and active processes, running constantly in the background and surfacing things you'd otherwise miss. It tracks relationships and sector context to flag when a target is gearing up for a process (and drafts the outreach in your voice), watches network activity across LinkedIn, news, and conference follow-ups, and surfaces where active processes stand, including what's at risk since you last looked.

name: o11
one_liner: Bespoke AI For Financial Firms
description:
o11 builds bespoke AI software for financial services firms. Every firm works differently: different deal processes, data rooms, CRMs, market data tools, Excel models, slide templates, IC memos, reporting workflows, and approval steps. The edge is not making a generic deck or model faster with ChatGPT. It is turning your firm’s historical knowledge, judgment, templates, data, and execution style into repeatable software.

name: Zymbly
one_liner: Automates admin for aircraft mechanics

name: Getcho
one_liner: The reliability platform for last-mile delivery
description:
Getcho is a local delivery platform for high-value goods. 

We are building a high-reliability delivery network on top of high-volume, unreliable fleets, just like how TCP builds reliable end-to-end networking on top of an unreliable base network (IP).

name: Freebuff
one_liner: The 100% free coding agent
description:
We're making consumer agent products completely free, using the best open source models, and funded by ads.

Our first product is a coding agent CLI called Freebuff. Install it with "npm i -g freebuff". We're also working on a free Lovable competitor.

name: ArchiLabs
one_liner: AI CAD for AEC
description: ArchiLabs is building the AI CAD tool for architects and engineers. We focus on use cases like: production homebuilding, modular housing, MEP, fire suppression systems, and more.

name: Null Labs
one_liner: End-to-end Simulation for Defense Autonomy
description: We provide defense companies with simulation infrastructure to train and validate autonomous systems.

name: dari.dev
one_liner: The Production Layer for AI Agents
description:
We let developers deploy AI agents as API endpoints with built-in tools, sandboxes, and durable execution.

Agents maintain state, run long-lived workflows, and handle retries automatically.

name: LogosGuard
one_liner: The sensitive data redaction layer for AI
description: Use AI tools like ChatGPT, Claude, and Gemini safely without leaking sensitive data. LogosGuard redacts your private information before the prompt ever leaves your device.

name: Telemetron
one_liner: Support and Operations Platform for Hardware Companies
description:
Telemetron is an AI-powered support platform tailored for hardware products (medical devices, consumer electronics, industrial hardware, robotics, and more). 

Our platform unifies ticketing, device diagnostics, order tracking, and product documentation into one intelligent system. Our AI agents connect directly to devices, APIs, and backend systems to deliver faster resolutions, smarter routing, and better support experiences.

name: Partcl
one_liner: Design a chip in minutes
description:
Partcl modernizes chip design automation with physics-informed models powered by GPU acceleration. 
Our tools run up to 700× faster than legacy solutions, cutting weeks off development and unlocking AI-driven optimization.

name: Almond
one_liner: A dual-arm robot built for physical AI.
description: We build robots for physical AI. Meet Axol - A dual-arm robot designed for real-world tasks using AI.

name: VoiceOS
one_liner: Say it and it's done. Voice is the new OS
description:
VoiceOS turns voice into a seamless, universal interface to 10x productivity — a true voice operating system for the next era of computing.

It works across any app, letting users speak naturally to dictate, edit, and write text instantly. Whether writing an email, revising a document, or grasping complex information, VoiceOS transforms voice into the most powerful productivity tool, bridging the gap between thought and expression.

name: Cartpole
one_liner: Building reinforcement learning environments
description: We're creating reinforcement learning environments for training frontier models.

name: Propolis
one_liner: Hands off QA via intelligent browser agents.
description: Propolis simulates real users via swarms of autonomous browser agents that test for you.
